verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM ships a built-in Copilot, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows Copilot or the CRM can connect to MCP servers. Pipeline Connect, where the vendor builds and hosts API integrations, and the Zapier-style integrations are related but different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
